page.overview:
Who is Atakan Cormoray?

Lord is the head of House Cormoray. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Lord Atakan is a handsome old man with a well-groomed salt and pepper beard, hair in dreadlocks adorned with rings, and dark skin with a slight reddish hue. His eyes were tired but serene and happy, indicating a wise, contented life. He had "fire at his fingertips", and wore deep orange and red robes held with a golden belt.

Lord Cormoray was present at the meeting of all the then-extant Sundered Houses called in Dol-Makjar by Lord Otto Einfasen to discuss the apparent machinations of House Tachonis. Atakan arrived in the form of a purple and red meteor. His main concern was initially with his missing daughter, Lady Amariya Dacen Cormoray, who appeared shortly thereafter, allaying his fears. Later, he became uncomfortable when Primus Tachonis brought up the celebrations at the old Kalystra quarries over the "grant at the Penteveral" going through.

Following the meeting, Lord Cormoray quickly accepted Primus Tachonis' offer of 10 million gold pieces in addition to land and titles in Telmora as recompense for his machinations to become the new imperial ruling house over the others. The following day the Cormorays started increasing their security at their estate, since most of their delegation was going to stay in the city for some time.
